# Thermodynamic state at a temperature and pressure

`eos.state_at_tp`

## Source

**Michelsen, M. L. (1982); NeqSim `ThermodynamicCoupling.ThermoProperties`**

The flash of `eos.pt_flash_check`, then the per-phase properties at its answer. The Kay pseudo-critical classification is azoth's screening label; NeqSim's `PhaseType` has no supercritical or dense member.

DOI: [10.1016/0378-3812(82)85001-2](https://doi.org/10.1016/0378-3812(82)85001-2)


## Algorithm

A model rather than a calculation: what this page pins down is the procedure,
not an equation, and both implementations read it from here.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Scheme | `successive_substitution_flash` |
| Convergence | `absolute` |
| Tolerance | `1e-10` |
| Max iterations | `300` |
| Initialisation | `wilson` |

## Inner procedure

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Scheme | `rachford_rice_bisection` |
| Convergence | `absolute` |
| Tolerance | `1e-14` |
| Max iterations | `200` |

## Inputs

| Name | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `components` | - | the substances the mixture is made of, by name, resolved against the component databank with the keycard's overrides applied. |
| `T` | K | absolute temperature. |
| `P` | Pa | absolute pressure. |
| `z` | dimensionless | overall mole fractions. Checked rather than renormalised. |
| `tolerance` | dimensionless | *Optional.* the flash's outer stopping tolerance; absent takes `algorithm.tolerance`, 1e-10. |
| `strict` | - | *Optional.* whether a flash cap raises; absent is true. False reports `converged = false`. |


## Outputs

| Name | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `phase` | two_phase / all_liquid / all_vapour / trivial | what the flash found. |
| `phase_class` | two_phase / single_phase_gas / single_phase_liquid / dense_single_phase / dense_supercritical / undetermined | the screening label; see the assumptions. |
| `converged` | - | whether the flash met its tolerance. |
| `vapour_fraction` | dimensionless | *Optional.* the vapour fraction where there is a split; absent for a single phase. |
| `x` | dimensionless | liquid-phase mole fractions; equal to the feed when single phase. |
| `y` | dimensionless | vapour-phase mole fractions; equal to the feed when single phase. |
| `molar_mass` | kg/mol | bulk molar mass. |
| `molar_volume` | m**3/mol | bulk molar volume, phase-fraction weighted. |
| `density` | kg/m**3 | bulk mass density, the molar mass over the molar volume. |
| `internal_energy` | J/mol | bulk molar internal energy, `h - P v`. |
| `enthalpy` | J/mol | bulk molar enthalpy. |
| `cp` | J/(mol*K) | bulk molar isobaric heat capacity. |
| `cv` | J/(mol*K) | bulk molar isochoric heat capacity. |
| `compressibility` | dimensionless | bulk compressibility `P v / (R T)`. |
| `system_sound_speed` | m/s | *Optional.* absent in this tranche; the caller uses `eos.equilibrium_sound_speed`. |
| `interface_tension` | N/m | *Optional.* absent in this tranche; the caller uses the surface-tension model. |

| Bound | On violation | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `T > 0` | raises | an absolute temperature; zero and below are not states |
| `P > 0` | raises | an absolute pressure; zero and below are not states |
| `tolerance > 0` | raises | a stopping tolerance; zero can never be met |

## Assumptions

- **one flash, then the properties at its answer.** The split is `eos.pt_flash_check`'s; the volumetric and caloric properties are `eos.molar_enthalpy_entropy`'s, the heat capacity `phase_capacity`'s, each at its phase's root and weighted by vapour fraction.
- A component's `Tc`, `Pc`, `omega`, molar mass and every `kij` come from the databank with the keycard's overrides applied; a keycard-defined pseudo-component therefore travels through the same path as a databank substance.
- the equation of state is Peng-Robinson with the coefficient `eos.pr_kappa` computes, and the mixture fugacity coefficient is the one `eos.pt_flash` uses.
- **the phase class is a screening label, not a stability analysis.** `two_phase` is the flash's split; the single-phase labels are its verdicts; the dense labels mark a state at or above the mixture's Kay pseudo-critical pressure, and `dense_supercritical` above its temperature.
- `tolerance` overrides the flash's outer stopping tolerance; `strict` is true when absent. `strict = false` returns the last iterate with `converged = false` and a warning, as `eos.pt_flash_check` does.
- `system_sound_speed` and `interface_tension` are optional and absent in this tranche; a caller wanting either calls `eos.equilibrium_sound_speed` or the surface-tension model. Absent is not zero.
- the enthalpy and internal energy are absolute from the ideal-gas model's datum (273.15 K, no formation enthalpy), so a caller uses differences. The datum cancels in every balance this state feeds.

## How far this is checked
**`partially_verified`** — exercised against expectations pinned in its own spec, with no independent oracle recorded for it - **the normal case rather than a defect**.

- Tests: 1 declared, every one run
- External check: no external validation case names it

The same account travels with every result this returns: `result.provenance`
carries the status, the spec and both kernels with a SHA-256 of each, and which
declared checks *that call* could not evaluate.

## References

- Michelsen, M. L. (1982). "The isothermal flash problem. Part I. Stability." Fluid Phase Equilibria 9(1), 1-19. DOI 10.1016/0378-3812(82)85001-2.
- NeqSim master `twophasepipe/ThermodynamicCoupling.java`, whose `ThermoProperties` aggregates per-phase density, enthalpy, cp, sound speed and surface tension after a `TPflash`. NeqSim has no all-in-one state method; this is an aggregate, not a port.
